title: Accessibility | Apple Developer Documentation - [Cognitive](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility\#Cognitive)
claim: Keep actions simple and intuitive.** Ensure that people can navigate your interface using easy-to-remember and consistent interactions. Prefer system gestures and behaviors people are already familiar with over creating custom gestures people must learn and retain.
supporting_text: **Keep actions simple and intuitive.** Ensure that people can navigate your interface using easy-to-remember and consistent interactions. Prefer system gestures and behaviors people are already familiar with over creating custom gestures people must learn and retain.
